Article Title: '90 seats, one crore votes': Revanth Reddy sets Congress' 2028 Telangana target
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Telangana chief minister A Revanth Reddy on Sunday expressed confidence that the Congress would return to power in the state by winning 90 of the 119 Assembly seats in the 2028 elections. Addressing the party's Political Affairs Committee (PAC) meeting in Hyderabad, he said the Congress leadership was preparing a strategy to strengthen the organisation and secure another term in office."Congress will secure 90 seats with one crore votes in the next assembly elections", the CM asserted.Reddy also told the newly-appointed AICC in-charge of party affairs in Telangana, BM Sandeep, that the state Congress should work towards making Rahul Gandhi the prime minister.He said Telangana would contribute 15 Lok Sabha seats to the Congress in the 2029 general elections, provided the total number of constituencies in the state remained at 17."You have to convey our consensus to Kharge ji, Rahul ji and Sonia ji," he told Sandeep.Revanth Reddy targets BRS over 'false propaganda'The chief minister also criticised the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS), accusing its leadership of spreading false narratives against the Congress government in an attempt to return to power.Taking a dig at BRS leaders over their recent protest outside the Assembly, where they took off their shirts after being stopped by the police, Reddy said, "BRS leaders took off their shirts outside the Assembly building recently (when they were stopped by police), and now their trousers will be removed.Warns Congress leaders against public criticismAgainst the backdrop of criticism from some ruling party leaders over his government, Reddy warned Congress members against making negative remarks about the government in public."We are closely observing everyone’s behaviour and the way they speak. The party has complete information on what each leader says in public and in private," he said.He added that leaders who remained aligned with the party's position would receive organisational and other posts in due course.Says Congress could have formed government at Centre in 2024Recalling the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Reddy said he had correctly predicted that the BJP would not cross 240 seats.He argued that had the BJP won 25 fewer seats, and the Congress secured 25 more, the Congress would have formed the government at the Centre.Reddy also recalled that former prime minister Indira Gandhi represented Medak in Telangana as a Lok Sabha member when she was assassinated in 1984. He said the state Congress should now resolve to make Rahul Gandhi the prime minister.Government preparing drought action planThe chief minister said the state government would reach out to people directly after the Sankranti festival in January 2027.He also said the government was preparing an action plan to address possible drought conditions caused by the adverse impact of the El Niño phenomenon.Reddy highlighted the welfare schemes being implemented by his government and recalled the challenges faced by Congress workers during the previous BRS regime.
Article Summary: Telangana chief minister A Revanth Reddy expressed confidence that the Congress would return to power in the state by winning 90 of the 119 Assembly seats in the 2028 elections. Reddy also told the newly-appointed AICC in-charge of party affairs in Telangana, BM Sandeep, that the state Congress should work towards making Rahul Gandhi the prime minister.

West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari on Monday announced that a resolution to rename the state as ‘Paschim Banga’ will be moved in the Assembly on December 9. The state Cabinet approved the proposal at a meeting earlier in the day.Speaking to ANI reporters in Kolkata, Adhikari said the resolution would be introduced during the Assembly’s winter session, scheduled from December 4 to 14. He also clarified that ‘Paschim Banga’ would be the state's name in English.“In English, too, West Bengal will be ‘Paschim Banga’. ‘Paschim Banga’—it must be written exactly as is. We are bringing a resolution to the Legislative Assembly on the 9th; following that, it will go to the Government of India and then to Parliament,” he told the news agency.The chief minister said the proposed change was linked to the state's history and its formation in 1947.“This is a matter of history—the history surrounding the formation of West Bengal, which took place in 1947. This change is something that ought to happen. Instead of ‘West Bengal’, it will be ‘Paschim Banga’,” he added.If passed by the state Assembly, the resolution will be sent to the Centre for approval. The renaming will require clearance from the central government and Parliament before it can formally take effect.The announcement follows remarks by West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya in October, when he indicated that the state would be renamed.
Article Summary: West Bengal chief minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that a resolution to rename the state as ‘Paschim Banga’ will be moved in the Assembly on December 9. The state Cabinet approved the proposal at a meeting earlier in the day. If passed by the state Assembly, the resolution will be sent to the Centre for approval.

Article Title: 'Stop acting like Baahubali': SC raps Bihar judicial officer for FIR against SP for disobeying directions
Article Text:
SC pulled up a Bihar judge for convicting an SP over non-compliance with directions to register an FIR

Poll Vote & Share your view Should the Supreme Court have the authority to criticize judicial decisions? Yes, it ensures accountability No, it undermines judicial independence 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday pulled up a Bihar judicial officer for convicting a police officer over non-compliance with directions to register an FIR. The top court questioned his understanding of contempt law and telling him not to "act like a Baahubali" while exercising judicial powers. The bench also suggested that the judicial officer be sent for training to the National Judicial Academy."Ask your client to stop acting like a 'Bahubali' while exercising judicial powers," Chief Justice Surya Kant said while hearing the judicial officer's plea against a Patna high court order staying his decision.A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana criticised district and additional sessions judge-IV, Rohtas at Sasaram, Anil Kumar for convicting the police officer on the same day and treating the non-compliance as an offence committed in the face of the court."We are really surprised at your understanding of law. You must first understand the scope and ambit of Section 384 BNSS and Section 345 CrPC. If someone slaps someone or abuses the court, or refuses to leave the courtroom when directed, that is an offence committed in the face of the court. But if we direct someone to register an FIR and they do not, it does not amount to a crime committed in the face of the court," news agency PTI quoted the bench as saying."Your understanding of law is appalling. You also took such an aggressive stance, called the superintendent and convicted him on the same day," Justice Bagchi said.Questioning the judge's objection to an inspecting judge's intervention, Justice Bagchi said, "Were you within your domain and jurisdiction when you called the district magistrate and superintendent of police, treated their non-appearance as an offence committed in the face of the court and convicted and sentenced him? You also stay your hands.Enough of adventure."On September 29, 2026, Anil Kumar convicted IPS officer Raushan Kumar, then superintendent of police (SP) of Rohtas, for wilfully disobeying court directions to register an FIR against a person who had allegedly given false evidence in a criminal case decided in 2023.The judicial officer imposed a symbolic fine of Rs 1 on the SP and directed Bihar's director general of police (DGP) to enter the court's observations into the officer's service records. He also called on the Union ministry of personnel and training to overhaul the training of IAS and IPS officers to better align them with a democratic setup.The Patna high court had subsequently stayed the order imposing the fine on the SP for contempt of court.
Article Summary: SC pulled up a Bihar judge for convicting an SP over non-compliance with directions to register an FIR. The top court questioned his understanding of contempt law and told him not to "act like a Baahubali" while exercising judicial powers.

NEW DELHI: Congress and Samajwadi Party (SP) concluded the first round of seat-sharing talks for 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections on Monday, with the top leaders describing it as "positive". The two parties are likely to finalise their agreement within the next two to four days, leaders of the two parties said, news agency PTI reported.SP general secretary Ram Gopal Yadav, who is heading the party's talks panel, said both sides had exchanged views and were optimistic about reaching an agreement soon."We expect to complete the alliance within the next two to three days. The second round of talks will be held tomorrow," PTI quoted Yadav as saying.The meeting was held at the residence of Congress Rajya Sabha MP Pramod Tiwari in the national capital. Leaders said the talks were progressing in a cordial atmosphere, but did not disclose the number of seats either party is seeking.Congress' Uttar Pradesh in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam also described the meeting as positive and said an agreement was close."The meeting went very well and was positive. We will reach an agreement very soon... it is almost finalised," he said."Since the talks are progressing positively, we will not comment on other details, and we will not disclose the seat-sharing details at this stage," he added.Gautam said the two parties would hold another meeting on Tuesday.Uttar Pradesh Congress president Aradhana Misra-Mona also expressed confidence that the arrangement would be finalised soon."I am not talking about numbers. Numbers are not important. ... we will meet again tomorrow, and everything will be finalised," she said, adding that the parties were likely to conclude the process within two to four days.Elections to the 403-member Uttar Pradesh assembly are due early next year. Chief minister Yogi Adityanath is seeking a third consecutive term, while the SP and Congress are looking to challenge the BJP's dominance in the state.The Congress and SP are working towards a joint contest in the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. The Congress is seeking a larger share of seats, citing the outcome of the last Lok Sabha elections and Rahul Gandhi's position as a prominent opposition leader nationally.The SP's negotiation panel is headed by Ram Gopal Yadav and includes party state president Shyam Lal Pal and Lok Sabha MPs Rajiv Rai and Iqra Choudhary. NEW DELHI: Congress general secretary and Punjab in-charge Sachin Pilot on Monday termed the reported possibility of a renewed alliance between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) in Punjab as “pure opportunism”, questioning what had changed since the two parties parted ways.He also criticised the Bhagwant Mann-led Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government and said Congress could provide an alternative ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.Addressing the media in Amritsar, Pilot questioned whether the issues that led to the BJP and Akali Dal ending their alliance had been resolved.“Look, the Bharatiya Janata Party has said all those things against the Akali Dal when their mutual agreement ended and for what reasons the alliance between the Akali Dal and BJP had broken. Have all those reasons disappeared?” he asked.Referring to reports of a possible reunion, he said, “The question that arises is: what caused the alliance to break, and what has changed today that you are going to form an alliance again?”Pilot alleged that both parties were struggling to regain their political footing in Punjab after facing rejection in Assembly and Lok Sabha elections.“Now, out of compulsion, they are holding each other's hands right before the elections,” he said.He also referred to the controversy over the three farm laws and allegations concerning drugs, asking the two parties to explain their political differences to voters.“I understand that you were separate for all five years, but what were all the things said regarding the three black laws on drugs? So many people lost their lives in the protest. The Akali Dal and the BJP should answer why they are together today. But I believe this is pure opportunism,” Pilot said.Turning his criticism towards the AAP government, Pilot said its tenure had run its course and claimed voters were looking for a change in Punjab. He also questioned Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's handling of issues in the state.“The Chief Minister has only told jokes and made lighthearted comments over the last five years. Action should be taken seriously on all issues. They haven't done that,” he said.Describing Punjab as “a border state, a very sensitive state”, Pilot said it needed a responsible government. He added that Congress could offer voters an alternative.“The people of Punjab want change, and the Aam Aadmi Party government's term is completely over. The public wants change, and change will happen, along with a better alternative system. If anyone can do it, the Congress party can,” he said.On Congress's preparations for the 2027 polls, Pilot said the State Election Committee would meet on Tuesday and that a screening committee had been formed. Candidates, he said, would be selected on merit, feedback and their prospects of winning.He also expressed confidence that the Congress-Samajwadi Party alliance would continue in Uttar Pradesh ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections, with seat-sharing talks expected to be finalised soon.
Article Summary: Congress general secretary and Punjab in-charge Sachin Pilot calls reported possibility of a renewed alliance between BJP and Akali Dal 'pure opportunism' Pilot also criticised the Bhagwant Mann-led Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government and said Congress could provide an alternative ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.

Article Title: 'Destroyed credibility of polls': Congress alleges gaps in voting data across 200 seats in Lok Sabha polls
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Congress on Sunday stepped up its attack on the Centre, alleging that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and home minister Amit Shah, through Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, had "destroyed" the credibility of Indian elections.In a post on X, Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh reiterated the party's demand for Kumar's resignation, saying PM Modi and Shah must be held accountable for "vote chori"."An investigation has revealed that ECI's internal records are missing for voters who voted after 5 pm in 200 seats in Maharashtra, Haryana and Jammu and Kashmir in 2024. The returning officer's reports contain no figures for the final hour of polling," he wrote.Ramesh claimed that the number of votes polled was supposed to be tallied every two hours to prevent manipulation, but alleged that this procedure was not followed.He also questioned the increase in voter turnout recorded after 5 pm, citing Maharashtra, where the final turnout was 76 lakh votes higher than the figures reported at 5 pm."These late evening votes have already been suspect for bogus voting: in Maharashtra, the final turnout was 76 lakh votes higher than (the figures) reported at 5 pm.How is this possible? For one assembly, Kopri-Pachpakhadi, it means one vote was cast every 15 seconds at each booth for a full hour," Ramesh said."The Modi-Shah duo, through CEC Gyanesh Kumar, have destroyed the credibility of India's elections. They must be held accountable for this grave crime against our democracy. The CEC must resign, and the duo must answer for vote chori," he added.Meanwhile, Congress has announced a series of programmes to step up its campaign against alleged electoral irregularities.The party will organise 'Samvidhan Raksha (Save Constitution)' marches across states on November 26, observed as Constitution Day. It will also launch a booth-level verification drive to check deleted voter names and hold village-level 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao (Save Elections, Save India)' chaupals.In a circular issued to Pradesh Congress Committee presidents, general secretaries, in-charges and other key office bearers, Congress general secretary (organisation) K C Venugopal said state committees would organise 'Samvidhan Raksha' marches on November 26.Ahead of the marches, Congress workers will undertake a 'Vote Rakshak' campaign, visiting every polling booth to verify the names of voters whose names have been deleted from electoral rolls.From November 29 to December 15, the party will organise village-level 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' chaupals based on the findings of the verification campaign.
Article Summary: PM Modi and home minister Amit Shah must be held accountable for "vote chori," says Congress general secretary. Congress has announced a series of programmes to step up its campaign against alleged electoral irregularities. The party will organise 'Samvidhan Raksha (Save Constitution)' marches across states on November 26, observed as Constitution Day.

NEW DELHI: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has summoned seven serving and retired Punjab government officials, including IAS and IPS officers, for questioning in a money-laundering case against suspended state DIG Harcharan Singh Bhullar, officials said on Sunday.Of the seven officials summoned, five are currently serving in the government, while the others have retired.The ED is also investigating their alleged links with Bhullar's aide, Krishanu Sharda, who has been arrested in the case.Kumar Rahul, secretary in Punjab's health and family welfare department, has been asked to appear before the ED on Monday, while Anand Sagar, staff officer to the commissioner of Faridkot division, has been summoned on November 25. Neeru Katyal Gupta, special secretary in the General Administration and Coordination Department, is scheduled to appear on November 26.The agency has also summoned two police officers. Fazilka SSP Gagan Ajit Singh has been called for questioning on November 26, while Ludhiana Police Commissioner Swapan Sharma has been asked to appear the following day.The two retired officials summoned are former bureaucrats.Gurpreet Sapra, who previously served as the Jalandhar Commissioner, has been asked to appear on November 26. Arun Sekhri, who served as divisional commissioner for Faridkot, Ferozepur and Jalandhar, has been summoned for questioning on November 25.The money-laundering case against Bhullar under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) stems from two FIRs registered by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) against him and his associates over alleged bribery and possession of assets disproportionate to their known sources of income.Bhullar, who was serving as Deputy Inspector General (DIG) of Police, Ropar Range, was arrested by the CBI in October 2025. The arrest followed a complaint by a scrap dealer who alleged that a bribe had been demanded from him through an intermediary to settle a case.
Article Summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has summoned seven serving and retired Punjab government officials, including IAS and IPS officers. The officials are being questioned in a money-laundering case against suspended state DIG Harcharan Singh Bhullar. Article Title: Son of Delhi doctor accused of killing domestic help dies; father moves court for interim bail
Article Text:
In photos: The accused Dr Manish Gupta; the victim domestic help





NEW DELHI: Dr Manish Gupta, an accused in the domestic help murder case, has approached a Delhi court seeking three weeks' interim bail following the death of his 19-year-old son, Parth Gupta, on November 19.Gupta has sought temporary release to attend his son's last rites and be with his family during the bereavement. He is currently in judicial custody after being arrested by Delhi Police on June 18, 2026, and is facing trial in the murder case before Saket District Court.Additional Sessions Judge Anuj Aggarwal took note of the application and directed Delhi Police to submit a verification report. The court has listed the matter for hearing on Saturday.Moving the application on Gupta's behalf, advocate Kamal Nayan Tiwari submitted that the accused was facing an extremely difficult situation following the sudden death of his only child. He argued that Gupta, as the deceased's father, had an emotional and moral responsibility to attend the last rites, but his continued custody had prevented him from doing so.The counsel told the court that he received a call from Gupta's wife on November 20, informing him that their 19-year-old son had died a day earlier. The application stated that the death had come as a devastating shock to the family and that Gupta was unable to be present with them because he was in custody.Parth was also named as a suspect in the charge sheet filed by Delhi Police in the domestic help murder case and had been questioned during the investigation.
Article Summary: Dr Manish Gupta, an accused in the domestic help murder case, has approached a Delhi court seeking three weeks' interim bail. His 19-year-old son, Parth Gupta, died on November 19. Gupta is currently in judicial custody after being arrested by Delhi Police on June 18, 2026.

Article Title: Rajasthan Congress chief demands CM Sharma resign over panchayat poll setback
Article Text:
PCC Chief Govind dotasara and LoP Tikaram Jully with Party workers Celebrate Panchayati Raj election results Friday





JAIPUR: Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) president Govind Singh Dotasra Friday demanded the resignation of chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and his cabinet, terming BJP’s setback in panchayat elections as “public anger” over alleged corruption, administrative lapses and unfulfilled promises.Addressing a news conference at the Congress office in Jaipur, Dotasra said the state govt was focused on optics rather than governance. “The state govt appears more interested in publicity and ceremonial events than addressing people’s problems,” he said.Taking aim at Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’s earlier description of BJP’s urban local body performance as a “landslide victory,” Dotasra argued the results did not support the claim. He said BJP’s lead over Congress was marginal and claimed that “nearly 64% of voters voted against it” in the urban polls.“People have exposed the PM’s claim (in rural polls). Modi should be wary of the ‘facts’ fed to him by Rajasthan BJP, which only ends up embarrassing him,” Dotasra said.He reiterated his demand for resignations, saying, “If the CM and his ministers have even a little moral responsibility left, they should resign and tell the PM and the Union home minister that they have failed to meet the expectations of Rajasthan’s people.”Dotasra alleged the Sharma govt failed to address inflation, healthcare, fertiliser and seed availability for farmers, employment and women’s safety. Referring to alleged irregularities in medicines and medical equipment supplied to pregnant women, he accused the govt of evading accountability for maternal deaths. He also alleged that job seekers were facing police action. Unemployed youth, he said, were being met with “batons and police action instead of recruitment opportunities. ”Dotasra also criticised Sharma over remarks directed at former chief minister Ashok Gehlot , saying Gehlot’s advice to keep relatives away from govt affairs stemmed from his experience as a three-term CM. “Instead of addressing the issue, the current CM appears rattled. The language he used against a former CM was unacceptable. Even a street drunkard would not use such language,” Dotasra said.Questioning Sharma’s emphasis on high-profile visits and public events, Dotasra took a swipe at the ceremonial aspects of VIP tours. “A ‘Radhe Radhe’ stole, a memento, a helicopter ride and visits by the PM and the Union HM—but what did Rajasthan’s people get? You are not running an event management company; you are running a govt,” he said.
Article Summary: Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) president Govind Singh Dotasra Friday demanded the resignation of chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and his cabinet. He terming BJP’s setback in panchayat elections as “public anger” over alleged corruption, administrative lapses and unfulfilled promises.

Article Title: Delhi Police issues public notice ahead of proposed SKM march to Jantar Mantar
Article Text: New Delhi: Ahead of the proposed protest march by the Samyukta Kisan Morcha (SKM) and other activists on Thursday, Delhi Police has issued a public notice clarifying that no permission has been granted for the proposed march from Kali Bari to Jantar Mantar.According to the notice, information has been received that the SKM and other activists are planning to organise a protest march on Thursday. However, the authorities have not received any application seeking permission for the proposed march, nor has any approval been granted.The police further stated that prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, are currently in force in the New Delhi district.Under the prevailing orders, unauthorised gatherings, processions, demonstrations, speeches, sloganeering and dharnas are prohibited.Appealing to the public and prospective participants to abide by the restrictions, the Delhi Police has urged everyone to comply with the prohibitory orders and cooperate with the police in maintaining law and order.The notice also cautioned that any violation of the prohibitory orders would invite appropriate legal action.The advisory comes ahead of the proposed mobilisation, with the police reiterating that any gathering or protest must adhere to the applicable legal requirements and restrictions.
Article Summary: The Samyukta Kisan Morcha (SKM) and other activists are planning to organise a protest march on Thursday. Delhi Police has issued a public notice clarifying that no permission has been granted for the proposed march from Kali Bari to Jantar Mantar.

Article Title: 'Offering flowers to Babasaheb crime in UP?' CJP's Saurav Das stopped at UP border
Article Text:
Saurav Das alleges he was stopped at the UP border while travelling to Meerut on Constitution Day

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das on Thursday alleged that he was stopped at the Uttar Pradesh border while travelling to Meerut to pay homage to BR Ambedkar on Constitution Day Das shared the claim on X, questioning why he was being prevented from visiting the city to offer flowers at Ambedkar's statue."I was on my way to Meerut to pay homage to Babasaheb Ambedkar ji's statue on Constitution Day. But I am stopped at the border and being disallowed," he said."Is offering flowers to Babasaheb a crime in UP today?" he added.The alleged incident comes days after Das was stopped at the immigration counter at Delhi airport while preparing to board a London-bound flight. He was scheduled to attend an event at the University of Oxford.Das moved the Delhi high court on Wednesday, challenging the action. In his petition, he alleged that immigration authorities prevented him from boarding the flight over discrepancies in his passport details, particularly his place of birth. He also said no order or travel restriction was shown to him.During Thursday's hearing, the Centre informed the court that Mumbai Police had issued a look out circular (LOC) against Das on November 23.The submission came after the court sought the Centre's response to his petition.Das's lawyer told the court that he had not been informed about the LOC or its purpose. The court also issued notices to the regional passport officer and the ministry of external affairs, seeking their responses by the next hearing. The matter has been listed for further hearing on December 9.CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke also questioned the decision to stop Das from travelling, drawing comparisons with the cases of fugitive economic offenders Vijay Mallya, Nirav Modi and Mehul Choksi.
Article Summary: Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) co-convenor Saurav Das alleges he was stopped at the Uttar Pradesh border. Das was travelling to Meerut to pay homage to BR Ambedkar on Constitution Day. He questioned why he was being prevented from visiting the city to offer flowers.

Article Title: 'Message to clean-shaven face & head': Owaisi's 'moustache' challenge to Yogi, Akhilesh over CM fight in UP
Article Text:
​Owaisi takes a swipe at Yogi Adityanath and Akhilesh Yadav, backing Chandrashekhar Azad as the Samajik Parivartan Morcha’s CM face for the 2027 UP polls

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi on Thursday took a swipe at Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath and Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav , saying neither would become the chief minister after the 2027 assembly elections.Addressing the Samajik Parivartan Morcha's first joint rally in Lucknow, he said the next chief minister would be someone with a moustache, in an apparent reference to alliance partner Chandrashekhar Azad."Someone remarked that this is an alliance between the bearded and the moustachioed. And, in truth, it is. Now, I wish to address that clean-shaven face and the other clean-shaved head, you will not become the CM anymore; it will be someone with a moustache..," he said.Owaisi accused the BJP and the Samajwadi Party of failing to protect the Constitution and ensure adequate political representation for Muslims.Invoking Dr BR Ambedkar, he said the Constitution guaranteed liberty, fraternity, justice and equality. He accused the RSS and the Sangh Parivar of working against these principles."Justice will not come through bulldozers or encounters. Justice will come through Babasaheb Ambedkar's Constitution.The rule of law will be restored," he said, targeting the BJP government.He also criticised the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, alleging that it was being used to weaken the Constitution.Targeting the Samajwadi Party, Owaisi accused its leadership of practising caste-based politics and seeking Muslim votes without ensuring adequate representation to the community."How many times will we be betrayed? Akhilesh Yadav, will you give a ticket to a Muslim from Karhal?" he asked. Yadav had won the Karhal seat in the 2022 Assembly elections.Owaisi accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Adityanath of promoting communal divisions while failing to address unemployment and concerns over education.He said the Morcha, if voted to power, would focus on education and employment for young people."We will ensure education for young people and jobs after they complete their education. We will make doctors and engineers, and ensure that our students get opportunity to study in IITs," he said.Referring to the 2013 Muzaffarnagar riots, Owaisi urged people to support the Morcha's candidates in the 2027 elections."The historic opportunity before us is that we should support neither the red cap (of Samajwadi Party) nor the RSS-BJP," he said.Praising Azad, Owaisi said he could represent the poor, oppressed and deprived sections of society."If there can be a chief minister in Uttar Pradesh who represents the poor, the oppressed and the deprived, and whose government will be of the people rather than only a particular section, his name will be Chandrashekhar Azad," he said."I am confident that with our unity, prayers and hard work, we will make Chandrashekhar Azad the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh. Together, we will prevent the BJP from forming the government for a third time," Owaisi said.
Article Summary: Owaisi backs Chandrashekhar Azad as the Samajik Parivartan Morcha’s CM face for the 2027 UP polls. Owaisi accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Adityanath of promoting communal divisions while failing to address unemployment and concerns over education.

Article Title: Former Tamil Nadu minister K N Nehru’s aide arrested in Rs 1,020crore tender scam case
Article Text:
Kavi Prasad





CHENNAI: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) arrested Kavi Prasad, an associate of former Tamil Nadu municipal administration minister K N Nehru, on Thursday in connection with an alleged Rs 1,020crore tender manipulation case. Prasad appeared before DVAC investigators in Chennai on Thursday morning following a summons and was formally arrested in the afternoon.The case relates to contracts awarded between 2021 and 2025, when Nehru headed the municipal administration and water supply department during the DMK regime. The DVAC registered an FIR on Sept 4, 2026, alleging that tender processes had been manipulated to favour selected bidders in Chennai, Tirupur and Coimbatore.Investigators alleged that commissions ranging from 7.5% to 10% of contract values were collected as illegal gratification. WhatsApp messages and calculation sheets reportedly referred to the payments as a “party fund.”According to the investigators, Prasad acted as an intermediary by arranging meetings between contractors and officials, obtaining advance information about projects and coordinating communications and money collection.He was described as an assistant to Nehru’s brother, N Ravichandran, and a former director associated with the TVH Group.Prasad was stopped at Chennai airport in September while attempting to travel to London after a look out circular was issued against him. He was questioned and released at that stage.The FIR named Nehru, his brothers K N Manivannan and N Ravichandran, representatives of the TVH Group, former MLAs, govt officials and contractors.
Article Summary: Kavi Prasad, an associate of former Tamil Nadu municipal administration minister K N Nehru, was arrested on Thursday. The case relates to contracts awarded between 2021 and 2025, when Nehru headed the municipal administration and water supply department during the DMK regime.

Article Title: ‘Z+ security won’t save you’: Gunmen fire at Mumbai jewellery shop after extortion threat
Article Text:
In Mahim, a jewellery shop experienced a firing incident linked to extortion threats demanding Rs 10 crore





MUMBAI: A firing incident at a jewellery shop in Mahim on Wednesday evening is suspected to be linked to an extortion threat demanding Rs 10 crore from the shop owner, who had allegedly received a series of threatening messages from unidentified numbers over the past month. Two men on a motorcycle fired two to three rounds at the shop before fleeing towards Bandra, police said.According to the complaint filed by Bharat Jain (45), owner of P.C. Jain Jewellery Shop on L.J. Road in Mahim West, he had received threatening messages on his mobile phone on October 18, October 24 and October 31. The messages allegedly threatened him with violence and demanded Rs 10 crore.In the last message, dated October 31, the accused allegedly wrote: "Ramji zyada samaga mat chala, teri janm kundli hai. Z Plus Security bhi laga rakh, paisa tujhe dena hoga. Yamraj ji ko mechana hai to ok, nahi to 10 crore dena hoga."Jain initially suspected that the messages were spam and did not lodge a police complaint, as he had no known dispute with anyone. However, on Wednesday, around 7.30 pm, two unidentified men arrived on a motorcycle outside his shop. The pillion rider allegedly pulled out a pistol and fired two to three rounds at the shop, shattering its glass door, before the duo fled.Jain and his employee, Namdev Gurav, were inside the shop at the time of the incident. Neighbouring shopkeepers rushed to the spot after hearing the gunshots. No injuries were reported.The shop owner subsequently examined CCTV footage from his shop and a neighbouring establishment, which allegedly captured the motorcycle's registration number, MH 15 AJ 3565, and details of the two suspects.The Mahim police have registered a case against two unidentified persons on charges of attempted murder and extortion, among other provisions, and are investigating the incident. Police are also examining the earlier threatening messages to establish the motive and identify the shooters.
Article Summary: Two men on a motorcycle fired two to three rounds at a jewellery shop in Mahim. The shop owner had received a series of threatening messages from unidentified numbers. The Mahim police have registered a case against two unidentified persons on charges of attempted murder and extortion.

Article Title: BJP corporator’s minor son booked after speeding SUV kills Beed couple; police say friend was driving
Article Text:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





The minor son of a BJP corporator was booked after a speeding SUV allegedly rammed a motorcycle head-on, killing a couple in Beed’s Majalgaon on Nov 20. Police, however, said a video shot inside the SUV shows the corporator’s son was not driving.The victims, Prahlad Gaikwad and his wife Sunita Gaikwad, were residents of Mangrul village near Majalgaon. According to a complaint filed by the couple’s son, the two were returning home on their motorcycle after attending a shraddha ceremony. Around 3.30 pm, near Saubhagya Mangal Karyalaya, an SUV allegedly came at high speed and hit their motorcycle head-on.Police subsequently booked the minor son of a local corporator under sections 106(1), 281 and 324(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and sections 134 and 187 of the Motor Vehicles Act. However, police said fresh evidence that emerged during the investigation indicates that the corporator’s son was not behind the wheel.Majalgaon police station in-charge Dhananjay Dhone said a video filmed inside the SUV, apparently for a reel, shows four friends in the vehicle before the crash.“It shows four friends inside the car, with the corporator’s son sitting next to his friend who was driving. The video also shows the airbags deploying after the impact. The corporator’s son was not driving. His friend was behind the wheel,” Dhone said.A section of local residents alleged that the crash was linked to road rage and illegal street racing. Police said that allegation has not been established.“The CCTV footage of the accident shows the SUV was at high speed. It is not yet clear whether any street racing was on,” Dhone said.Police are recording statements of those involved. No arrests had been made till Monday evening.The BJP corporator, meanwhile, also denied that his son was driving or that the SUV was involved in street racing. “My son’s friend was driving the car and he appeared before the police after the accident. My political rivals are trying to target me and my family after the accident,” he said.
Article Summary: The minor son of a BJP corporator was booked after a speeding SUV allegedly rammed a motorcycle head-on, killing a couple. Police, however, said a video shot inside the SUV shows the corporator’s son was not driving. A section of local residents alleged that the crash was linked to road rage and illegal street racing. Police said that allegation has not been established.

Article Title: ​Rajya Sabha MP Wadkute passes away
Article Text:
Ramrao Wadkute

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Rajya Sabha member and BJP leader Ramrao Wadkute died at AIIMS in New Delhi late on Saturday after suffering a severe heart attack. He was 72.Wadkute was admitted to AIIMS on Nov 20 after complaining of cough and chest discomfort. He suffered a heart attack and died while undergoing treatment, party leaders said.A resident of Kalamnuri in Hingoli district, Wadkute was a prominent leader of the Dhangar community in Marathwada and was known as a simple, grassroots politician.Condoling his death, chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said Wadkute’s demise was the loss of a simple and dedicated political leader who was deeply committed to grassroots welfare.“He shouldered many organizational responsibilities for the BJP in Hingoli district. He did a great deal of work for the Dhangar community. He left his mark on the cooperative sector as well. His concern for grassroots communities was always evident,” the CM said.Wadkute began his political career with Nationalist Congress Party and served as a member of Maharashtra Legislative Council from June 2014 to Oct 2019. He was also president of Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Maharashtra Sheep and Goat Development Corporation Limited.He left the NCP in Oct 2019 and joined the BJP. In 2021, he was appointed BJP’s Hingoli district president. He also served as the party’s election chief and in-charge for the Hingoli Lok Sabha constituency. The BJP nominated him for the Rajya Sabha from Maharashtra in March this year.BJP Hingoli district president Gajanan Ghuge said last rites on Wadkute were scheduled on Tuesday morning. “His body will be flown to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on Monday, and will be taken to Parbhani first and later at Hingoli. The last rites will be performed when his daughter arrives from the US,” he said.Wadkute is survived by his wife, two sons and a daughter.
Article Summary: Wadkute was admitted to AIIMS on Nov 20 after complaining of cough and chest discomfort. He suffered a heart attack and died while undergoing treatment, party leaders said. He was a prominent leader of the Dhangar community in Marathwada.

Article Title: Raut claims Rs 150cr being offered to MPs to back delimitation bill, Mahajan says allegations childish
Article Text:
File photo

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed on Saturday that MPs were being offered “Rs 150 crore to back the proposed delimitation bill”, even as BJP minister Girish Mahajan dismissed it as a “childish allegation”.Raut also said that BJP would not return to power in 2029 if the current political atmosphere and public pressure continued. He added that Congress party’s performance in Rajasthan’s panchayat elections reflected the country’s changing mood.Interacting with the media during his visit to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on Saturday, Raut alleged that BJP was attempting to secure support for the proposed delimitation bill and questioned why a Parliament session was not being convened.“Remember this figure if Maharashtra ’s MPs support the bill,” Raut said, alleging that some prominent politicians in the state had been entrusted with arranging the money and securing support. He also questioned Union home minister Amit Shah ’s frequent visits to Mumbai over the past two months, alleging that political negotiations were being conducted from the city.BJP minister Girish Mahajan, speaking in Jalgaon, said that Raut makes “childish allegations.No one takes him seriously anymore.”Raut said Congress’s good performance in Rajasthan’s panchayat samiti and zilla parishad elections was the outcome of public pressure preventing electoral malpractice and keeping the election machinery under check. “If this public pressure continues until 2029, the BJP will not return to power. It is not 100% but 500% certain,” he said.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed MPs were being offered “Rs 150 crore to back the proposed delimitation bill’ Raut also said that BJP would not return to power in 2029 if the current political atmosphere and public pressure continued.

Article Title: Row over how much senior counsels were paid to appear for hearing over petition challenging co-op ordinance passed by Maha govt
Article Text:
Kolhapur:





Congress MLC Satej Patil has accused Mahayuti govt of spending Rs 80 lakh on senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi to defend an ordinance allowing four nominated members voting rights in major cooperatives. BJP hit back, claiming Patil too spent Rs 1.8 crore to engage senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi for the same hearing, including Rs 1 crore on a chartered flight.Patil shared on social media a state govt resolution dated Nov 23 approving Rs 80 lakh as Rohatgi’s fee for appearing before Bombay high court’s vacation bench on Nov 9.“Mahayuti govt brought the ordinance to overturn the mandate given to our panel in the Gokul dairy election. It then spent Rs 80 lakh to ensure the ordinance passed the legal test,” Patil said. “If the ordinance was legally sound, why was there a need to engage a senior constitutional lawyer? Govt is normally represented by experienced lawyers under the advocate general. Instead, it chose to bring in senior counsel. ”Rohatgi appeared online for the state, while Singhvi represented 13 directors of the Patil-led panel. The high court declined to stay the ordinance, following which Mahayuti won the Gokul dairy chairman’s election with the support of four nominated directors.BJP spokesperson Navnath Ban defended the payment to Rohatgi and levelled a countercharge against Patil. “Govt-panel counsel are paid according to the rules, and Rohatgi was paid Rs 80 lakh accordingly. I want to ask Satej Patil where the Rs 1.8 crore he allegedly spent on one hearing came from,” Ban said.Ban claimed Patil spent Rs 1 crore on a chartered flight to fly Singhvi between Delhi and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar for the Nov 9 hearing and another Rs 80 lakh on his legal fee.Minister Hasan Mushrif said senior counsel are engaged when required to strongly present govt’s case and suggested the advocate general’s absence may have necessitated Rohatgi’s engagement.“Govt has paid the fee for the services it sought. So far, we have spent from our own pockets to fight the case,” Mushrif said.
Article Summary: Congress MLC Satej Patil accused Mahayuti govt of spending Rs 80 lakh on senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi to defend an ordinance allowing four nominated members voting rights in major cooperatives. BJP hit back, claiming Patil too spent Rs 1.8 crore to engage senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi for the same hearing.

Article Title: 50-year-old man accused of spiking woman's drink, raping her at Belapur lodge

NAVI MUMBAI: A 25-year-old woman on Monday lodged a rape complaint at CBD-Belapur police station against habitual offender Shailendra Dwivedi (50), who allegedly posed as a journalist.Dwivedi was arrested by Ulwe police on November 12 in a cheating and criminal breach of trust case for allegedly duping Thane trader Vijay Jha and four others of Rs 19 lakh in a flat sale deal. Article Title: SC grants bail to Gadchiroli doctor jailed for 4 years in UAPA case
Article Text:
Nagpur:





Four years in prison, zero witnesses apparently examined, and a factual error by the Nagpur bench of Bombay High Court led Supreme Court on Wednesday to order the release on bail of a Gadchiroli doctor jailed under Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) for alleged Maoist links. The bench reaffirmed that Article 21 overrides stringent UAPA curbs.Citing Union of India versus K A Najeeb (2021), the apex court bench led by Justice Dipankar Datta held statutory bail restrictions under Section 43D (5) of UAPA do not bar constitutional courts from granting bail when prolonged pre-trial incarceration infringes upon fundamental rights.The appellant doctor had moved Supreme Court after his bail plea was rejected by the Nagpur bench of Bombay High Court on July 20. The high court had held the doctor, who was granted temporary bail in 2024 from Oct 19-23, did not surrender till Jan 2, 2025. The SC said, “it does appear the high court was particularly influenced by the appellant’s belated surrender”, but it was “grossly in error”. Scrutiny of the custody certificate issued by Nagpur Central Prison showed the doctor had surrendered on Oct 24 itself. The apex court said this shows the doctor “did not abscond for two-and-half months as the impugned order would suggest”.The case goes back to July 2022 when police arrested the doctor and two others in a Maoist-hit forested area in Gadchiroli, and police stated they were found “indulging in suspicious activities”. The prosecution stated a banner propagating Maoist ideology was seized from “their personal belongings”. Later, police claimed to have searched the doctor’s home and “recovered items implicating him”.The Maharashtra govt opposed the doctor’s bail, citing his primary role in the offence, the likelihood of tampering with evidence and influencing witnesses, as well as the gravity and seriousness of alleged offences.The defence, however, argued the doctor had simply discharged his duty as a medical officer, and any involvement with members of guerrilla faction was restricted to such role.The SC bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu found a “strong case for bail”, pointing to the long wait for trial, since charges were framed this July, more than three years after the case reached the Gadchiroli sessions court. The bench said the doctor must furnish bail bonds and attend trial diligently, leaving the trial court to set other conditions for cancelling bail for any breach or tampering.Senior Advocate Siddharth Aggarwal, with Manan Daga, Akriti Chaubey, Sidhant Saraswat, Japman Singh, Darshan Sejwal and Rajendra Daga, appeared for the appellant doctor, while Siddarth Dharmadhikari and Aaditya Aniruddha Pande represented the state.
Article Summary: A doctor was jailed under Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) for alleged Maoist links. The doctor had moved Supreme Court after his bail plea was rejected by the Nagpur bench of Bombay High Court on July 20. The high court had held the doctor, who was granted temporary bail in 2024 from Oct 19-23, did not surrender till Jan 2, 2025.

Article Title: Youth stabbed for opposing eve-teasing at sister’s haldi
Article Text:
Nagpur:





A 19-year-old youth was allegedly stabbed twice in the stomach after intervening in an eve-teasing incident during his sister’s haldi ceremony at their residence in Prerna Nagar, under Hudkeshwar police limits, late Tuesday.The injured youth has been identified as Piyush Gupta . The complainant, Tejas Hadge, was also present at the function. According to police, the incident occurred after some youths allegedly harassed the sisters of Tejas’s friends, Sachit Nighore and Vedant Barde, triggering an altercation at the venue.When Piyush and Tejas intervened, the accused allegedly abused them. As tensions escalated, one of the accused attacked Piyush with a sharp weapon, disrupting the wedding celebrations and triggering panic among guests.Piyush, who sustained serious abdominal injuries, was rushed to the Trauma Centre at Government Medical College and Hospital, where he is undergoing treatment.

Article Title: School fraud case: Ex-minister Anbil Mahesh, ex-MLA Muthukumar taken into police custody
Article Text:
Former school education minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi was recently questioned by CCB police about the alleged collection of money from private school managements on the promise of govt approvals

Chennai:





Chennai Central Crime Branch (CCB) on Wednesday took former school education minister Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi, former MLA Muthukumar and the latter’s car driver Saravanan into police custody for further interrogation in a case involving an alleged fraud of more than ₹100 crore from private school managements.CCB took custody of the trio following an order passed by Chennai special court for corruption cases on a plea moved by the agency. Mahesh was already subjected to interrogation in custody of CCB for three days from Nov 2.Special judge L S Sathiyamurthy passed the order while allowing the plea moved by CCB. According to CCB, they wanted to interrogate the three accused to ascertain who collected the money, how much was collected from private schools and who ultimately received the money.According to the accused, the police had already interrogated all three accused sufficiently during their earlier periods of custody and that they should not be permitted to take them into custody again.Prosecution argued that the police needed to investigate the involvement of govt officials in the alleged irregularities. She sought permission to take all three accused into custody together for two days.The issue pertains to a case registered by CCB’s Economic Offences Division III. According to the complaint, money exceeding ₹100 crore was collected from private school managements by promising to secure govt approvals, including permanent recognition, upgradation of school status and clearances from Directorate of Town and Country Planning (DTCP).Anbil Mahesh, 48, Muthukumar, 47, and Saravanan, 49, were taken into police custody from 11am on Nov 25.
Article Summary: CCB took custody of the trio following an order passed by Chennai special court for corruption cases on a plea moved by the agency. Mahesh was already subjected to interrogation in custody of CCB for three days from Nov 2. According to the complaint, money exceeding ₹100 crore was collected from private school managements by promising to secure govt approvals.

Article Title: Tirupur farmers hold protest seeking full waiver of cooperative crop loans
Article Text: TIRUPUR: More than 100 farmers held a protest in front of the Tirupur district collectorate condemning state govt for not fully waiving cooperative crop loans. They urged govt to implement the complete waiver promised during the elections.The agitation was led by N Ramesh, Tirupur city and district secretary of Tamil Nadu Farmers Protection Association. He said chief minister C Joseph Vijay, during the poll campaign, had assured that cooperative crop loans would be waived fully for farmers owning under five acres and by 50% for those owning above five acres, without conditions, calling it a “guarantee.”Ramesh said Tamil Nadu’s farmers had availed cooperative crop loans of around Rs 20,000 crore, but govt initially announced only Rs 2,000 crore in the first phase, triggering widespread disappointment. Following sustained protests by farmers and farm bodies, the relief ceiling for beneficiaries was raised, with the amount increased to Rs 35,000 from an earlier Rs 5,000 for farmers with loans above Rs 1 lakh, he said.He added that more than 50 farmers’ organisations had formed a federation and held continuous sit-in protests. Later, during talks in Chennai, it was announced that Rs 75,000 would be provided to all, he said.However, farmers alleged that multiple conditions remained and those who took crop loans during 2022, 2023, 2024 and in Jan-April 2025 were left out. With monsoon failure linked to El Nino and worsening drought, they said repayment is impossible and fresh loans are unavailable. Farmers submitted petitions to the district collector and the joint registrar of cooperatives.
Article Summary: More than 100 farmers held a protest in front of the Tirupur district collectorate condemning state govt for not fully waiving cooperative crop loans. They urged govt to implement the complete waiver promised during the elections. The agitation was led by N Ramesh, Tir upur city and district secretary of Tamil Nadu Farmers Protection Association.

Article Title: Land surveyor, middleman booked for accepting bribe near Coimbatore
Article Text: COIMBATORE: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) has registered a case against a land surveyor and a middleman in Sulur for accepting a bribe of Rs 25,000 to survey a parcel of land and facilitate the issuance of a separate patta.The accused have been identified as Balamurugan, 35, a govt-licensed land surveyor attached to the Sulur taluk office, and Praveenkumar, 32, who runs an e-service centre in the area.According to DVAC officials, Arun Kumar, a milk trader from Pollachi, owns a piece of land at Kalangal near Sulur. He approached Balamurugan in late August to survey the property and provide the necessary documents for obtaining a separate patta. Balamurugan demanded Rs 20,000 to survey the property and recommend to the tahsildar the issuance of a separate patta. Unwilling to pay the bribe, Arun Kumar lodged a complaint with the chief minister’s special cell.After learning about the complaint, Balamurugan increased the demand by Rs 5,000 and insisted that Arun Kumar pay Rs 25,000. He allegedly instructed him to transfer the money through GPay to Praveenkumar, the middleman.Arun Kumar transferred the amount, following which the property was surveyed, and the documents were handed over to him.Arun Kumar subsequently informed the Coimbatore DVAC officials about the bribery. After obtaining govt permission, the DVAC registered a case under the Prevention of Corruption Act against both men on Tuesday. Further investigation is under way.
Article Summary: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) has registered a case against a land surveyor and a middleman in Sulur. The accused have been identified as Balamurugan, 35, and Praveenkumar, 32, who runs an e-service centre in the area.

Article Title: Man held for damaging two Karunanidhi statues, glass panels of DMK library and office in Erode
Article Text:
The Erode district police launched an intensive investigation and examined CCTV footage. The footage revealed that the same man had visited the various locations and caused the damage.





ERODE: The Erode district police on Tuesday arrested a man on charges of damaging two statues of late Tamil Nadu chief minister M Karunanidhi , a library and a DMK party office.The incidents came to light after the spectacles on the Karunanidhi statue at Panneerselvam Park in Erode were found broken. The Karunanidhi statue at Alangattu Valasu in Modakkurichi was also damaged.“The glass panels of a library situated beneath Karunanidhi’s statue in the Municipal Colony area were damaged. In another incident, the front glass facade of the DMK district headquarters at Manalmedu was found shattered,” said a party functionary.The Erode district police launched an intensive investigation and examined CCTV footage. The footage revealed that the same man had visited the various locations and caused the damage.“Based on the investigation, police identified the suspect as Hari Vignesh, 26, of Thottipalayam Pudur near Modakkurichi,” said superintendent of police D V Kiran Shruthi. The man, who was drunk on Monday night, also damaged the doors and window panes of his own house as well as the windows of some vehicles.Police said legal action would be initiated. Preliminary inquiries indicated that the man might be suffering from mental health-related issues.
Article Summary: The incidents came to light after the spectacles on the Karunanidhi statue at Panneerselvam Park in Erode were found broken. The glass panels of a library situated beneath the statue were also damaged. The front glass facade of the DMK district headquarters at Manalmedu was found shattered.

Article Title: Man arrested for assaulting police constable in Coimbatore
Article Text: COIMBATORE: A 37-year-old man was arrested on charges of assaulting and abusing a police constable while the latter was on duty at Kurichi in the city on Sunday.The arrested man has been identified as G Boopathi of Gandhi Road near Kurichi.According to police, S Sanjeev Gandhi, a Grade II police constable attached to the Sundarapuram police station, was on patrol duty with a police inspector near the Indian National Congress party office on Sunday. Boopathi, a committee member of the Aravan temple, picked an argument with the constable over a temple festival. During the argument, he grabbed the constable’s uniform, pushed and abused him, obstructed him from discharging his official duties and threatened to murder anyone who tried to stop him. Onlookers intervened and separated him from the cop.Sanjeevanandhi lodged a complaint with the Sundarapuram police on Sunday. Police registered a case under sections 296(b), 132 and 351(2) of BNS.Boopathi was remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: A 37-year-old man was arrested on charges of assaulting and abusing a police constable while the latter was on duty at Kurichi in the city on Sunday. The arrested man has been identified as G Boopathi of Gandhi Road near Kurichi. He was remanded in judicial custody.

Article Title: TNEB employee held with ganja in Mettur
Article Text:
Salem





: A suspended electricity board employee was arrested on Saturday for smuggling ganja on his two-wheeler in Mettur.Police identified the arrested person as M Joseph, 47, of Matha Kovil area in Mettur. According to an investigation officer, Joseph was nabbed while they were conducting a routine vehicle check along the right bank of Mettur dam on Kolathur Road.“He was riding a two-wheeler in a suspicious manner. Upon inspecting the vehicle, we found 900 grams of ganja concealed inside the seat cover. We seized the contraband and took Joseph to the police station for interrogation.”Investigations revealed that Joseph was already facing a ganja smuggling case, which had led to his suspension from the electricity board.Police registered a case, arrested him and produced him before the Mettur court, which remanded him in judicial custody. Joseph was subsequently lodged in the Salem Central Prison.
Article Summary: A suspended electricity board employee was arrested on Saturday for smuggling ganja on his two-wheeler. Police identified the arrested person as M Joseph, 47, of Matha Kovil area in Mettur. Joseph was already facing a ganjan smuggling case, which led to his suspension from the electricity board.

Article Title: 864 bottles of liquor seized from house near Erode; man arrested
Article Text: ERODE: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district in the early hours of Thursday and arrested a man.Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid at the house of K Govindaraj, 28, of Ammapalayam. They found 864 bottles of IMFL stocked in the house for illegal sale.Police registered a case and arrested Govindaraj. He was remanded in judicial custody.They launched a search for Sekar alias Ammasai, 34, and Sridhar, 38, who have links with the illegal liquor operation.
Article Summary: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district. Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid.

SALEM: A govt school teacher was arrested in Salem district on Sunday night under sections of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act on charges of inappropriate behaviour towards girl students.The arrested teacher, M Sankar, 49, of Vinayagapuram, is serving as a social science teacher in a govt school in the district.According to the complaint, the teacher allegedly made inappropriate remarks to Class X girl students on Nov 5. “He is accused of making a heart-shaped hand gesture towards one student and calling another student ‘Cleopatra’ while commenting on the beauty of her eyes,” said an officer at the all women police station in Attur.The students brought the matter to the notice of the headmaster on Nov 13. The headmaster informed chief educational officer A Ellappan and contacted Childline 1098 seeking intervention.Following the complaint, a member of the child welfare committee visited the school on Nov 14 and conducted an inquiry into the allegations raised by the students.Based on the findings, the headmaster lodged a complaint with the Attur all women police on Sunday. Police registered a case against Sankar and arrested him. He was remanded in judicial custody.

Article Title: Five Sabari pilgrims booked for assault on KSRTC driver
Article Text:
An Ayyappa devotee attacking a KSRTC driver at Vyttila

Maradu police registered a case against five Sabarimala pilgrims for attacking a KSRTC bus driver near Maradu after the bus rammed their tempo traveller near Thykoodam Flyover around 1.30pm on Tuesday. The KSRTC bus running on the Thiruvananthapuram-Palakkad route was descending the flyover when it hit the side of the van. The case was registered based on a complaint filed by Maneesh M, a KSRTC employee from Pattambi in Palakkad.According to the FIR, the first accused allegedly entered the bus through the driver’s side door and slapped Maneesh. The others ‘pulled and tore’ his uniform and damaged the tag attached to his identity card. The third accused verbally abused the complainant and attempted to ‘attack’ passengers inside the bus. The fourth accused allegedly pulled out the vehicle’s key, while the fifth allegedly stamped on Maneesh’s right leg, injuring him and preventing him from discharging his duties.The complaint also stated that the accused disrupted the bus service, resulting in an estimated loss of Rs 25,000. Maradu police registered a case against the accused under BNS Sections 329(1), 121(1), 296(b), 324(4) and 3(5).
Article Summary: Maradu police registered a case against five Sabarimala pilgrims for attacking a KSRTC bus driver near Maradu. The accused were identified as Thrissur natives Renjith (35), Lal Krishna Das (34), Jishnu (32) and Jithin (30)

Article Title: Exalogic pay-off case: Kerala HC extends stay on probe against ex-CM Pinarayi Vijayan, kin
Article Text:
Kochi:





The high court on Wednesday extended its previous order till Dec 15, directing the vigilance department to keep the investigation against former chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan and his relatives in the CMRL-Exalogic pay-off case in abeyance and staying a single bench order directing the registration of a vigilance case in the matter.A bench of Justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji issued the interim order on appeals filed by Vijayan, his daughter Veena T, son-in-law and former minister P A Mohamed Riyas and others, after the Supreme Court set aside an earlier division bench order and restored the appeals for fresh consideration. The HC will consider the appeals on Dec 15.The case originated from a communication sent by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) to the state police chief recommending the registration of a case under the Prevention of Corruption Act against Vijayan, Veena, Riyas and others in connection with the alleged pay-off. However, instead of registering a vigilance case based on the recommendation, the state govt constituted a special investigation team (SIT) to conduct a preliminary inquiry before registering an FIR. Acting on a petition filed by activist K M Shajahan challenging this procedure, the single bench set aside the arrangement and directed the registration of a case under the PC Act.Vijayan and others subsequently filed leave applications seeking permission to challenge the order, contending that it had been passed without hearing them. The division bench dismissed the applications and appeals, holding that an accused public servant had no right to be heard before an FIR was registered. The appellants then approached the Supreme Court through special leave petitions (SLPs), which set aside the division bench order and restored the appeals to the HC for fresh consideration.
Article Summary: The high court extended its previous order till Dec 15, directing the vigilance department to keep the investigation against former chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan in abeyance. The case originated from a communication sent by the Enforcement Directorate to the state police chief recommending the registration of a case under the Prevention of Corruption Act.

Article Title: Sexual assault case: Keralam’s Congress-led govt takes firm stand against former MLA Rahul Mamkootathil over denial of mobile phone passcodes
Article Text:
Former Palakkad MLA Rahul Mamkootathil

Kochi:





Amid an escalating row within the Congress party over alleged social media attacks against Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan involving former MLA Rahul Mamkootathil and others, the state govt on Wednesday took a firm stand against the former MLA, arguing that he was required to provide the passcodes of his mobile phones seized in connection with a sexual assault case.Director general of prosecution (DGP) T Asaf Ali made the submission in response to a petition filed by Mamkootathil challenging a magistrate court order directing him to provide the passcodes of the phones, seized by the investigating officer for forensic examination. The DGP argued that an accused cannot claim constitutional protection to withhold passcodes required for a lawful criminal investigation.Considering the legal questions concerning the right to privacy, protection against self-incrimination and the investigating agency’s power to access digital evidence, Justice C Jayachandran decided to appoint an amicus curiae to assist the court. The bench further adjourned the petition to Dec 9.After Mamkootathil’s arrest in the case in Jan 2026, police had seized two mobile phones belonging to him and sent them to the Central Forensic Science Laboratory for examination. However, the data could not be accessed as the phones were protected by passcodes. Subsequently, the police approached the JFCM court in Thiruvalla, seeking a direction to Mamkootathil to provide the passcodes.The magistrate court allowed the request, prompting Mamkootathil to approach the HC. He contended that compelling an accused to provide the passcodes to his mobile phones would violate Article 20(3) of the Constitution, which protects an accused against being compelled to be a witness against himself, and Article 21, which guarantees the fundamental right to privacy. However, the state govt strongly opposed the petition on Wednesday.
Article Summary: Former Palakkad MLA Rahul Mamkootathil was arrested in a sexual assault case in January 2026. Police had seized two mobile phones belonging to him and sent them to the Central Forensic Science Laboratory for examination. However, the data could not be accessed as the phones were protected by passcodes. Subsequently, the police approached the JFCM court in Thiruvalla, seeking a direction to Mamkootsathil to provide the passcodes to the police.

Article Title: Man arrested for assault on copassenger aboard Abu Dhabi-Kochi flight
Article Text:
The incident occurred around 7pm on Tuesday aboard an IndiGo flight: AI image

Kochi

A passenger was arrested after allegedly assaulting a fellow traveller and attempting to strangle him with a belt aboard an IndiGo flight from Abu Dhabi to Kochi. Roshan Martin from Vyttila was arrested by Nedumbassery Airport Police on Wednesday and remanded in judicial custody.Yusuf (50) from Akalad in Thrissur allegedly sustained an injury near the outer corner of his right eye after Martin punched him in the face, breaking his spectacles. The accused allegedly took off his belt and tightened it around the victim’s neck following the assault.The incident occurred around 7pm on Tuesday aboard IndiGo flight 6E1404, while the aircraft was mid-air. Roshan was seated in 30D and the victim in 31B. A disagreement between the two reportedly escalated into an argument, prompting cabin crew members to intervene.Nedumbassery Airport Police registered the case on Wednesday based on a complaint filed by the airline’s assistant manager (security). Martin was booked under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita sections related to voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous means.
Article Summary: Roshan Martin from Vyttila was arrested by Nedumbassery Airport Police on Wednesday and remanded in judicial custody. The incident occurred around 7pm on Tuesday aboard an IndiGo flight from Abu Dhabi to Kochi. A disagreement between the two reportedly escalated into an argument, prompting cabin crew members to intervene.
